newsitem.title: PERU: Peru rebels free five diplomat hostages in siege.
newsitem.headline: Peru rebels free five diplomat hostages in siege.

text.p: Peruvian guerrillas holding up to 490 hostages in the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima released five captives on Wednesday, including ambassadors from Germany, Canada, Greece and France, witnesses said.
The fifth hostage could not be immeditaely identified.

"We have been freed by the (guerrillas) to serve as a contact and bridge with the Peruvian government with the aim of looking for a solution through negotiation that avoids bloodshed," the Canadian ambassador, Anthony Vincent, told reporters after his release.
"We will immediately contact the government and we have promised to maintain a personal link by telephone with the command of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA)," he added.
Among the remaining hostages were two Peruvian ministers and at least 11 more ambassadors from Asia, Europe and the Americas.
